name: remotion-studio
summary: 该技能的文档说明如何在 Cursor 中用 `npx remotion studio` 启动 Remotion Studio。Remotion 项目须能正常运行，Studio 会在浏览器中打开，方便你预览视频修改效果，再决定如何调整。

The skill’s documentation shows how to open Remotion Studio from Cursor with `npx remotion studio`. Once the Remotion project can run, Studio opens in the browser so you can review video edits before making further changes.
